entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I'm calling about an order. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for the Aero Race Jersey and when I finally went to wear it, it's just... it's not right.
I'm very sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the jersey or more of a preference issue with the fit?

Oh, there's no tear or anything. It's just the wrong size. It's way too tight, and I can't even zip it up properly. I feel terrible, I've been a loyal customer for so long and this has never happened.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me see what we can do. Can I get your order number, please?

Yes, it's VF-8862451. I was really hoping I could do an exchange or something. Honestly, with my budget, I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out. I feel so silly for waiting to try it on.
No reason to feel silly, it happens. Thank you for that number. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It was delivered 45 days ago.
Oh no... is that too long? I was so busy...
Not at all. For our standard apparel like this jersey, our return policy is 90 days. You are well within that window.
Really? Oh, that is such a relief! Thank you so much.

Of course. I can absolutely process this for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on file right now. You can use that to send the jersey back to us, and once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund. Would you prefer that, or would you like to set up an exchange for a larger size?
The refund would be perfect. Thank you, David. You've really made my day.
I'm glad I could help. The email has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Have a great day.
